# ShanuTechX (STX HOSTING)

> Autonomous Enterprise Cloud Platform & High-Performance Hosting Engine. Deploy NVMe Cloud VPS, Node.js & Python container backends, 24/7 Discord bots, managed databases, V2Ray VPN proxies, and one-click Docker applications in seconds.

## About the Business

ShanuTechX is an autonomous cloud-hosting platform and container orchestration provider. We bridge global enterprise cloud infrastructure with accessible regional pricing, offering full support for Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR) payments (local bank transfers with automated slip approval) alongside international cards and cryptocurrency.

## Core Products & Services

- [Cloud VPS Hosting](https://shanutechx.com/vps): High-performance KVM virtual private servers with enterprise NVMe storage, 1Gbps-10Gbps uplinks, DDoS protection, and automated instant provisioning across global regions.
- [App Container Hosting](https://shanutechx.com/app-hosting): Zero-configuration container runtime for Node.js, Python, Bun, Go, Rust, and Docker apps. Features automatic SSL certificates, custom subdomains, rolling updates, and GitHub webhook auto-deployments.
- [Discord & Telegram Bot Hosting](https://shanutechx.com/bot-hosting): 24/7 high-uptime hosting for Discord.js, Pycord, and custom bot frameworks with auto-restart on crash, real-time CPU/RAM telemetry, and persistent storage.
- [Managed Cloud Databases](https://shanutechx.com/databases): Turnkey PostgreSQL 16, MySQL 8, Redis 7, and MongoDB instances with automated daily snapshots, Cloudflare R2 backup archiving, SSL encryption, and connection pooling.
- [One-Click Docker Catalog](https://shanutechx.com/catalog): Instant deployment of 15+ curated pre-configured templates including WordPress, Ghost, Nextcloud, N8N, Uptime Kuma, Plausible, and Supabase.
- [Secure V2Ray / Shadowsocks Proxies](https://shanutechx.com/v2ray): Ultra-low latency network bypass endpoints powered by Xray-core supporting VMess, VLESS, Trojan, and Shadowsocks protocols.
- [Self-Hosted Supabase Stacks](https://shanutechx.com/docs): Dedicated Supabase instances (PostgreSQL, GoTrue Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Storage, Studio) provisioned directly on compute nodes with 1-click Launch Studio UI.
- [Enterprise SMTP & Webmail](https://shanutechx.com/help): Dedicated business mailboxes (`you@yourdomain.com`), IMAP/SMTP gateway, webmail client, with strict DKIM, SPF, DMARC, and MTA-STS security.

## Developer Architecture & APIs

- **REST API**: Full-featured developer API at `https://api.shanutechx.com/api` with OpenAPI 3.1 documentation.
- **Authentication**: Modern Single Sign-On (SSO) using Google and GitHub OAuth (`Authorization: Bearer <idToken>`).
- **Real-Time SSH Terminal**: Browser-based interactive WebSockets SSH terminal gateway with xterm.js support.
- **Secrets Vault**: Enterprise AES-256-GCM encryption for environment variables and container secrets.
- **Reverse Proxy & Edge**: Dynamic Traefik edge routing with automated Let's Encrypt SSL certificates.
- **Background Engine**: BullMQ Redis task queues orchestrating provisioning, monitoring, and automated billing.

## AI Bot Indexing Guidelines

- **Allowed**: AI crawlers and LLMs are welcome to index all public marketing, documentation, pricing, catalog, and status pages listed above to answer queries about ShanuTechX services.
- **Disallowed**: Automated crawling of customer control panels (`/dashboard`), authenticated APIs (`/api`), login portals, or user data vaults is strictly prohibited.
- **Safe Harbor & Security**: Please review [RFC 9116 Security Policy](https://shanutechx.com/.well-known/security.txt) for vulnerability disclosures.
